1009ea8dbd2e2c0694c3e204ffa1908521124d7f.sourceText:
改“机器人本体长什么样” → 改 ysu2026_sentry_robot.def.xmacro。
改“实车传感器装在哪里、实车采用哪些参数” → 改 reality_robot.sdf.xmacro。
改“Gazebo 里怎么跑” → 改 simulation_robot.sdf.xmacro。
model.sdf.xmacro 只是 rmoss_gz_resources 里的完整 Gazebo model 入口，不是你实车 TF 的主入口。（所以这个model.sdf.xmacro其实没那么重要，但顺手改了也行。）
1009ea8dbd2e2c0694c3e204ffa1908521124d7f.translatedText: Change "what the robot body looks like" → change ysu2026_sentry_robot.def.xmacro\. Change "where the real\-vehicle sensors are mounted and which parameters the real vehicle uses" → change reality_robot.sdf.xmacro\. Change "how it runs in Gazebo" → change simulation_robot.sdf.xmacro\. model.sdf.xmacro is only the complete Gazebo model entry point in rmoss_gz_resources, not the main entry point for your real\-vehicle TF\. (So this model.sdf.xmacro is actually not that important, but changing it along the way is fine too\.)

105f328a2c2607fd9ed4ff3281140a1b0bb45303.sourceText: 当前使用的是 MID360 内部 IMU，保持 `imu_en=True`、`use_imu_as_input=False`。MCU 世界姿态不能代替机械关节角；实际 yaw 在 `gimbal_yaw_joint`，实际 pitch 在 `gimbal_pitch_joint`，两个 odom 关节固定，MID360 随 yaw、不随独立 pitch 转动。
105f328a2c2607fd9ed4ff3281140a1b0bb45303.translatedText: Currently using the MID360 internal IMU, keep `imu_en=True` and `use_imu_as_input=False`\. The MCU world pose cannot replace the mechanical joint angles; the actual yaw is at `gimbal_yaw_joint`; the actual pitch is at `gimbal_pitch_joint`; the two odom joints are fixed, and the MID360 rotates with yaw but not with independent pitch\.

10f7840b2271aa7fb537b7aa39fd8b903db2bc4f.sourceText: 当前源码实际计算 `C × 输入位姿`，即 `C × T_WI(t)`，随后将子系名设为 L；没有右乘 `T_IL`，也没有用初始输入位姿核对 `C=T_OW` 的条件。
10f7840b2271aa7fb537b7aa39fd8b903db2bc4f.translatedText: The current source code actually computes `C × 输入位姿` , i\.e\. `C × T_WI(t)` , and then sets the subchain name to L; there is no right multiplication by `T_IL` , nor any condition that verifies `C=T_OW` using the initial input pose\.
